source.text: Dear confused right-wing friends: my article was about Monday's car incident, not the Ottawa shooting this morning https://t.co/dPCtNJW3mv

selection_rule: Strict explicit stance only. Support means the comment accepts Greenwald's distinction, argues that facts/motive were unknown, or says analyzing causes is not defending violence. Oppose means the comment rejects the distinction, says the two incidents are effectively the same, or accuses Greenwald of defending/minimizing terrorism.
note: Selected 30 explicit comments with balanced stances. Pure insults without a clear relation to the source, jokes, link-only comments, and unrelated side-thread replies were excluded.
